scorecard.label: Returns on capital
scorecard.headline: ROIC 10% (last) · 12% 4y avg
scorecard.detail: NOPAT ÷ (equity + LT debt − cash). High, stable ROIC is the core compounder signal.

scorecard.label: Moat
scorecard.headline: Gross margin unavailable
scorecard.detail: Sustained high gross margin is circumstantial evidence of pricing power. Not a substitute for judging the source of the moat.

scorecard.label: Owner earnings
scorecard.headline: FCF ÷ net income 73% avg
scorecard.detail: Free cash flow (CFO − capex) as a share of reported net income. Persistent <70% means earnings aren't turning into cash.

scorecard.label: Management & capital allocation
scorecard.headline: Reinvests at high ROIC; share count rising
scorecard.detail: Proxy: returns on reinvested capital plus diluted-share-count trend. Real capital-allocation judgement still needs the proxy statement.

scorecard.label: Price vs. value
scorecard.headline: Needs live price — computed in-app
scorecard.detail: EPS, FCF/share and book value are in the dossier; Orion computes P/E and FCF yield against the live quote so valuation is never stale.
